result_preview.shortDescription: Automates bill-of-materials validation and supplier compliance verification across engineering changes.
result_preview.description: Monitors engineering changes and product item modifications to automatically validate material specifications against supplier qualifications and regulatory requirements. Coordinates material compliance checks and automates BOM update workflows to ensure all component sourcing adheres to supplier qualification standards and compliance policies.

result_preview.description: Monitors engineering changes and material specifications to automatically validate bill of materials compliance against supplier qualifications. Coordinates BOM updates with product item definitions while processing supplier approval workflows. Automates compliance verification across product variants to ensure manufacturing readiness and regulatory adherence.

result_preview.title: BOM Compliance Validator Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously validates bill of materials against regulatory and supplier qualification requirements.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically scans product bills of materials to verify compliance with regulatory standards, restricted substance directives, and active supplier qualifications. It flags non-compliant materials and components, recommends approved substitutes, and generates compliance documentation for product records. This reduces manual review cycles and ensures products meet market-specific requirements before engineering release.
